## Why This Is Asked

- Reliability governance, SLIs/SLOs, error budgets
- Incident response, blameless culture
- Runbooks, on-call rotations, postmortems
- Cross-region traffic routing and release gates

```javascript
// compute p95 latency from samples
function p95(latencies){latencies.sort((a,b)=>a-b); const idx=Math.floor(0.95*latencies.length); return latencies[Math.min(idx, latencies.length-1)];}
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you adapt this plan if latency budgets are breached in one region but not others?
- What changes if a new feature increases p95 latency by 20%?
